name: 97301 · Salem, OR
findings: ZIP 97301 (Salem) has 313 nonprofit organizations. 144 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 122 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97301 (Salem) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97301 (Salem) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 122 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.
